# Support

- **Questions and ideas** — [Discussions](https://github.com/NimbusCMS/nimbus/discussions)
- **Bugs** — open an issue on the relevant repository, with reproduction steps
- **Security** — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); never a public issue
- **Plugin authoring** — [ADR 0001](https://github.com/NimbusCMS/nimbus/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-plugin-contract.md)
  and [plugin-markdown](https://github.com/NimbusCMS/plugin-markdown)

NimbusCMS is pre-release and maintained in spare time. Issues get read; not all
of them get fixed quickly.
